description: CSV processing pipeline + FastAPI upload endpoints. Implement the worker CSV parser and cleaner (T-05, T-06 from tasks.md) and add the two FastAPI upload endpoints (POST /uploads/intent and POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete) plus the Pydantic schemas they need. This feature is independent of FEAT-001's CloudFormation YAML but depends on backend/s3_client.py and backend/sqs_client.py from FEAT-001 — implement after FEAT-001 is complete.
steps: Step 1: Write `worker/exceptions.py` — define `InvalidCSVError(Exception)` with a `.message` attribute. Docstring must explain the permanent-vs-transient failure distinction: InvalidCSVError = permanent (worker returns cleanly, SQS deletes message); other exceptions = transient (propagate out, SQS retries after visibility timeout).

Step 2: Write `worker/csv_processor.py` — implement: (a) `AnalysisResult` dataclass with column_names: list[str], column_count: int, row_count: int, rows: list[dict]; (b) `CleanResult` dataclass with cleaned_rows: list[dict], duplicate_rows_removed: int; (c) `parse_and_analyse(file_path: str) -> AnalysisResult` with the full validation contract from AD-21 (empty file, duplicate headers, empty header names, invalid UTF-8, malformed CSV, wrong row field count — all raise InvalidCSVError; UTF-8 BOM stripped via utf-8-sig encoding; mixed CRLF/LF handled natively by csv.reader); (d) `clean(rows: list[dict]) -> CleanResult` — trim first (strip whitespace from all string values), then deduplicate using a set of tuple(row.items()) keys (first occurrence wins); (e) `write_csv(file_path: str, column_names: list[str], rows: list[dict]) -> None` using csv.DictWriter with extrasaction='ignore'. All functions need full WHY/HOW docstrings.

Step 3: Write `tests/unit/test_csv_processor.py` — cover the full AD-21 validation contract: valid CSV happy path (correct row_count/column_count/column_names), header-only CSV (row_count=0), empty file raises InvalidCSVError, binary file raises InvalidCSVError, duplicate headers raise InvalidCSVError, empty header name raises InvalidCSVError, row with extra fields raises InvalidCSVError, UTF-8 BOM handled (first column name does not start with \ufeff), mixed CRLF/LF parses correctly. Cleaner tests: no duplicates all retained, all identical rows deduplicated to 1, rows identical only AFTER trim are deduped (proves trim-before-dedup order), write_csv output re-readable by csv.DictReader with identical content.

Step 4: Write `backend/schemas.py` — Pydantic v2 models: `UploadIntentRequest` (user_email: str, original_filename: str, file_size_bytes: int), `UploadIntentResponse` (job_id: str, upload_url: str, s3_key: str), `UploadCompleteResponse` (job_id: str, status: str). Full docstrings explaining why these schemas exist as separate Pydantic models (not inline dicts).

Step 5: Modify `backend/main.py` — add two new routes. Do NOT change any existing code (health endpoint, CORS middleware, existing imports). Only add: imports for the new modules (boto3 not needed directly — use s3_client and sqs_client), the two route functions, and the two Pydantic schema imports. Route 1 — POST /uploads/intent: reads user identity from X-Dev-User-Id / X-Dev-User-Email headers (ENVIRONMENT=local bypass per AD-19), generates a deterministic S3 key `uploads/{user_id}/{job_id}/original.csv`, calls create_job() and generate_presigned_upload_url(), returns UploadIntentResponse. Route 2 — POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete: calls get_object_size() to verify upload happened, checks size <= 52428800 (return 422 if too large, per AD-27), calls transition_to_queued() (return 409 if False), calls send_job_message(), returns UploadCompleteResponse with status='queued'.

Step 6: Write `tests/unit/test_upload_endpoints.py` — use FastAPI TestClient + moto @mock_aws. Tests: POST /uploads/intent returns 200 with job_id/upload_url/s3_key, creates a Job in the DB in pending_upload status; POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete with a file present in mocked S3 returns 200 with status='queued' and transitions the job to queued; POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete with file too large returns 422; POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete for non-existent job returns 404; POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete called twice returns 409 on second call.
acceptance_criteria: Running `PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_csv_processor.py -v` passes all new CSV processor tests
Running `PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_upload_endpoints.py -v` passes all new upload endpoint tests
Running `PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/ -v` passes ALL unit tests with no regressions
worker/exceptions.py exists with InvalidCSVError documented with the permanent-vs-transient failure distinction
worker/csv_processor.py implements the full AD-21 validation contract (trim-then-dedup order enforced)
backend/main.py has POST /uploads/intent and POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete routes
findings: All 6 steps completed. Files created: worker/exceptions.py (InvalidCSVError with permanent-vs-transient failure distinction documented), worker/csv_processor.py (AnalysisResult + CleanResult dataclasses, parse_and_analyse with full AD-21 validation contract including BOM stripping via utf-8-sig, CRLF/LF handling, empty file, binary, duplicate headers, empty header names, wrong field counts; clean with trim-before-dedup order enforced; write_csv with csv.DictWriter), backend/schemas.py (UploadIntentRequest, UploadIntentResponse, UploadCompleteResponse Pydantic v2 models), backend/main.py modified to add POST /uploads/intent and POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete routes (existing health endpoint, CORS config, and imports unchanged), tests/unit/test_csv_processor.py (32 tests covering full AD-21 contract plus cleaner and write_csv round-trip), tests/unit/test_upload_endpoints.py (15 tests using @mock_aws + StaticPool SQLite for thread-safe in-memory DB sharing with TestClient). Technical note: used sqlalchemy.pool.StaticPool in endpoint tests (not conftest sqlite_db) because FastAPI TestClient runs ASGI in a background thread, and SQLite SingletonThreadPool creates a separate empty in-memory DB per thread. StaticPool forces all threads to share one connection. Total tests: 131/131 passing (53 original + 31 FEAT-001 + 32 FEAT-002 CSV processor + 15 FEAT-002 endpoint tests).
